name: Blinded helmet session with questionnaires
summary: The full question flow around one blinded real/sham helmet session: expectancy and state before, a 4-minute rest, the program itself (Sensed presence, right temporoparietal), a free report first and only then the checklists, a blinding guess, and the reveal at the end. The free report comes before any checklist because checklist wording shapes what people report (Lifshitz et al. 2019). In the sham-controlled study by Granqvist et al. (2005), suggestibility and absorption, not the field, predicted experiences; this flow lets you test that in your own data. An untested design.
setting: Quiet, dim room, eyes closed or a blindfold, seated or reclined. Helmet fitted in the temporal layout (see Placement) and connected; safety screening done in the Safety tab. Ideally the enrollment battery was done on an earlier day.
cautions: Trait effects appear in both arms and are not evidence of a field effect. If you sense a frightening presence or feel distressed, stop, turn on the light and talk to someone; seek help if it persists. No alcohol or drugs before a session.

sources.title: Granqvist P et al. (2005) Sensed presence and mystical experiences are predicted by suggestibility, not by the application of transcranial weak complex magnetic fields. Neurosci Lett 379:1-6
Maij DLR, van Elk M (2018) Getting absorbed in experimentally induced extraordinary experiences
Lifshitz M, van Elk M, Luhrmann TM (2019) Absorption and spiritual experience: a review of evidence and potential mechanisms. Conscious Cogn
Bang H, Ni L, Davis CE (2004) Assessment of blinding in clinical trials. Control Clin Trials 25:143-156

steps.title: Expectations
steps.instructions: Before anything runs, answer the questions about what you expect.

steps.title: Your state now
steps.instructions: Rate how you are right now.

items.label: Alcohol, cannabis or other drugs in the last 12 hours (0 = no, 1 = yes)
Caffeine in the last 4 hours (0 = no, 1 = yes)

steps.title: Fit the helmet
steps.instructions: Fit the helmet in the temporal layout and close your eyes or put on the blindfold. The program will be real or sham; neither you nor anyone present will know which until the end.

steps.title: Rest
steps.instructions: Rest quietly with your eyes closed. Nothing is running yet; this is your baseline.

steps.title: The program
steps.instructions: The program runs now, real or sham. Keep your eyes closed and let whatever happens happen. There are no questions until it ends.

steps.title: Free report
steps.instructions: Before any checklist, describe in your own words anything you experienced, or that nothing happened.

steps.title: Real or sham?
steps.instructions: Guess whether the field was real or sham, and how sure you are.

steps.title: Reveal
steps.instructions: Only now is the condition revealed. If you felt a threatening presence or distress, take your time, talk to someone you trust, and seek help if it stays with you.
